name: Knockdown
effect: Target becomes Prone on hit. Requires overage 2+.

name: Disarm
effect: Target drops held weapon on hit. Opposed Strength.

name: Feint
effect: Target’s next Defend vs you is at −2.

name: Called Shot
effect: Declare a specific location. On hit: apply relevant Condition (Blinded, Restrained, etc.).

name: Overrun
effect: Move through a target’s zone. Target may Defend or be pushed.

name: Shield Bash
effect: Requires shield. +1 attack; target Prone on overage 3+.

name: Aimed Shot
effect: Spend 1 Action aiming. Next ranged attack this round +2, ignores partial cover.

name: Flurry
effect: Make two attacks at −1 each. Both use the same Action.

name: Counter
effect: On successful Defend: immediately make a free attack at −2 (no Action cost).
notes: Overlaps the Duelist Specialty's Riposte. Kept for now (DECISIONS.md).

name: Shove
effect: Opposed Strength. On win: push target 1 band and Prone.
